Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075105. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, and compound_structures. Filter by standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, and non-null pChEMBL value. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Limit to 1000 rows.
